name: laravel/laravel
description: The skeleton application for the Laravel framework.

scripts.rector:complementarios: vendor/bin/rector process app/Services/Complementarios app/Repositories/Complementarios app/Http/Controllers/Complementarios app/Models/Complementarios
scripts.rector:seeders: vendor/bin/rector process database/seeders/PaisSeeder.php database/seeders/ParametroSeeder.php database/seeders/SedeSeeder.php database/seeders/DepartamentoSeeder.php database/seeders/CentroFormacionSeeder.php database/seeders/ProductoSeeder.php database/seeders/RolePermissionSeeder.php database/seeders/TemaSeeder.php database/seeders/ComplementariosSeeder.php database/seeders/PisoSeeder.php database/seeders/BloqueSeeder.php database/seeders/RegionalSeeder.php database/seeders/TestingSeeder.php database/seeders/DatabaseSeeder.php database/seeders/ComplementariosAvanzadoSeeder.php
test:coverage: docker run --rm -e COVERAGE_TESTS -e COVERAGE_DB=/tmp/cdattg_testing_coverage.sqlite -e COVERAGE_HTML -v ./:/app -w /app php:8.4-cli bash /app/tools/run-coverage.sh
test:coverage:html: docker run --rm -e COVERAGE_HTML=1 -e COVERAGE_TESTS -e COVERAGE_DB=/tmp/cdattg_testing_coverage.sqlite -v ./:/app -w /app php:8.4-cli bash /app/tools/run-coverage.sh
test:coverage:smoke: docker run --rm -e COVERAGE_DB=/tmp/cdattg_testing_coverage.sqlite -e COVERAGE_TESTS="tests/Feature/HomeControllerTest.php tests/Feature/Livewire tests/Unit/Commands tests/Modulos/Inventario/Feature/Controllers tests/Modulos/Complementarios/Feature/Controllers/ProgramaComplementarioControllerTest.php tests/Modulos/Complementarios/Feature/Controllers/EstadisticaComplementarioControllerTest.php" -v ./:/app -w /app cdattg-coverage bash /app/tools/run-coverage.sh
test:coverage:fast: docker run --rm -e COVERAGE_TESTS -e COVERAGE_DB=/tmp/cdattg_testing_coverage.sqlite -e COVERAGE_HTML -v ./:/app -w /app cdattg-coverage bash /app/tools/run-coverage.sh
test:coverage:fast:smoke: docker run --rm -e COVERAGE_DB=/tmp/cdattg_testing_coverage.sqlite -e COVERAGE_TESTS="tests/Feature/HomeControllerTest.php tests/Feature/Livewire tests/Unit/Commands tests/Modulos/Inventario/Feature/Controllers tests/Modulos/Complementarios/Feature/Controllers/ProgramaComplementarioControllerTest.php tests/Modulos/Complementarios/Feature/Controllers/EstadisticaComplementarioControllerTest.php" -v ./:/app -w /app cdattg-coverage bash /app/tools/run-coverage.sh
